Use JQL with the Jira project key. A key is the prefix of an issue key, for example `ABC` in `ABC-123`.

```
project = ABC
```

Most of the time you also want only open work that is yours:

```
project = ABC AND assignee = currentUser() AND statusCategory = "To Do"
```

Other useful parts:

| Want | JQL |
|---|---|
| Several Jira projects | `project in (ABC, DEF)` |
| One epic | `parent = ABC-42` |
| One sprint | `sprint in openSprints()` |
